text:
jon: Quick summary from this morning's A100 vs H100 sweep across 7B/13B chat models in us-east1 and europe-west1.
jon: Ran combined prefill+decode runs, batch sizes [1,4,8,16], seq=1024, warmup 200 steps. Plots uploaded to /files/1823456789/throughput.png :chart_with_upwards_trend:
jon: Key median throughput (tokens/sec) across devices: 
jon: - llama-2-7b: A100 1,200 tps, H100 2,300 tps (~1.9x)
jon: - mosaic-13b: A100 520 tps, H100 960 tps (~1.85x)
jon: - pf-13b-chat: A100 430 tps, H100 780 tps (~1.8x)
jon: Prefill latency (avg per-token, 512-token window):
jon: - 7B: A100 ~18ms/token, H100 ~10ms/token
jon: - 13B: A100 ~42ms/token, H100 ~24ms/token
maya: nice numbers. did you include quantized variants (int8/int4)?
jon: yes — ran bitsandbytes int8 and a triton-q4 profile. Int8 on H100 gave ~10-18% tps uplift vs fp16; on A100 the uplift was ~6-9%. int4 reduced mem but introduced more OOMs on A100 for batch>8.
jon: bench command used (example):
jon: ```bash
jon: ./run_bench --model hf-13b-chat --device h100 --batch 8 --seq 1024 --quant int8 --warmup 200 --out ./out.json
jon: ```
alex: any notable kernel differences? (cutlass vs triton vs custom)
jon: triton-kernel-v2 + flash-attn wins on H100 across most runs. On A100, cutlass still competitive for large-batch prefill, but flash-attn fused kernels cut tail latency on decode. Fused QKV kernels reduce prefill by ~12% on H100.
jon: region diffs: us-east1 H100 stable; europe-west1 H100 ~5-7% slower (thermal/NVLink config?). A100 had ~3% jitter across AZs.
jon: quick cost estimates (on-demand baseline prices used: A100 $3.00/hr, H100 $6.50/hr; util=70%):
jon: - 7B $/1M tokens: A100 ~$0.92, H100 ~$0.52
jon: - 13B $/1M tokens: A100 ~$2.60, H100 ~$1.50
jon: these fold in runtime (kernels + IO) and our prefilling overhead assumptions.
sam: interesting — so H100 is win for latency and cost per token despite higher hourly price?
jon: yep for interactive workloads where latency matters. For extremely high-batch offline jobs, A100 spot pools still beat cost if you can tolerate higher latency.
maya: any stability / OOM notes we should call out for onboarding docs?
jon: pf-13b-chat + int4 on A100 had 2 OOMs at batch=12; fixed by raising KV shard allocation and lowering batch. Also saw one segfault on cutlass kernel when using seq>2048 (repro file attached).
ci-bot: Build 2026.03.20-117 deployed benchmark suite to bench/prod.
jon: next recommended actions:
jon: - prefer H100 for latency-sensitive routes (chat/streaming) and mark in model catalog
jon: - keep A100 spot pools for high-throughput non-interactive workloads
jon: - add a region preference flag for H100 (prefer us-east1) in rollout policy
jon: - run a dedicated canary for quantized hf-13b-chat in staging, focus on int8 on H100
jon: raw artifacts uploaded: /shared/bench/1823456789/{summary.csv,per_run.json,plots.zip}
maya: I'll draft a short RFC with tables + cost calc and link to the artifacts.
alex: can infra use the CSVs to suggest autoscaling targets?
jon: yes dropped CSVs to /shared/bench/1823456789/, includes per-worker tokens/sec and p50/p95 latency slices.
sam: :thumbsup:
jon: tagging @alex and @maya for follow-ups on capacity sizing and RFC.
